statement: Written before any builder strategy was promoted. A SEPARATE forward family next to forward-lab/v1 (forward_lab_rule.json, family 1,276, unchanged). Do not tune on results: a changed rule is a new version. Nothing here switches trading on: QUALIFIED / CONSISTENT / ready are recorded findings; paper trading a builder strategy is a human decision taken only after its qualification; LIVE stays impossible.
members: every builder strategy ever promoted by builder.py (builder_rule.json 'proven'), registered on the snapshot end T of its batch; the forward sample starts with the first session AFTER T
family_rule: family_size = every builder strategy ever registered under this rule (demoted ones included); it never decreases; strategies added later raise it for later looks only
daily_pnl: per processed forward session since registration: net (the builder's costs and slippage) of the strategy's trades that EXIT that session, zero when none; trades still open at the data end (window_end / period_end) are never booked
computation: each run recomputes the strategy over [registration, session] on the builder data layer cut at the session (stratlab.builder_source ServerSource upto=session; the data are anchored, so earlier sessions never change) through the same engine as its evaluation, in a separate process; a session is processed only when both the minute store and the NSE archive contain it

looks.rule: look k at the 20k-th forward session (k = 1..12); the sample is exactly the first 20k sessions; each look is evaluated once, written to the registry chain and never recomputed

qualification.alpha_per_test: alpha_family / (family_size x max_looks) (Bonferroni over every builder strategy ever promoted and the looks)
qualification.test: forward_lab.qualification_test: H0 mean daily net <= 0, stationary block bootstrap of the centred daily series (mean block 5, 10,000 resamples, seed sha256('<id>|look<k>')), z = mean / sd(bootstrap means); QUALIFIED iff mean > 0 and z >= z_required with >= 50 closed trades and >= 40 sessions in the look sample; looks short of either are 'insufficient'
qualification.permanence: QUALIFIED is permanent unless the strategy is later demoted

consistency.reference: the strategy's own VALIDATION + FINAL daily net series from its builder evaluation (zeros on sessions without an exit)
consistency.test: at each look with >= 30 closed trades: band = 1 % quantile of the means of n-session stationary-bootstrap samples (mean block 5, 10,000 resamples, seed sha256('<id>|consistency<k>')) of the reference; INCONSISTENT iff the forward mean < band; latched

demotion.rule: forward max drawdown of the daily series > 1.5 x the reference's max drawdown -> DEMOTED, permanently

ready: ready = QUALIFIED and not INCONSISTENT and not DEMOTED. It is a flag for a human; nothing reads it to trade
schedule: runs at the end of forward_lab.daily_job (16:45 IST, FORWARD_LAB_ENABLED and BUILDER_ENABLED, PAPER) and processes every complete pending session (at most 10 per run); with no builder strategy registered it does nothing
